items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The funerals he played with Manuel Perez, but the carnival parades he played with Jake Steve.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Do you remember which bands did he play with Manuel Perez on that or some of the other bands?
The funerals he played with Manuel Perez, but the carnival parades he played with Jake Steve.
